data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Attractions & Tickets, enter city, enter keyword, search, sort, open a result) with the right parameters in order, but it lacks the final action step (view nearby or add to favorites) and calls the keyword optional, so a built automation would stop after opening the result.
